name: jira-acli
description: acli-first Jira/Confluence toolkit: a pure-mechanics acli skill (bulk work-item ops via JQL, ADF↔markdown conversion) paired with jira-content (Bug/Story/Task/Epic/Sub-task + comments) and confluence-content (Spec/PRD pages), each owning its product's canonical templates. Atlassian MCP is the fallback, not the default.
